text: B1c rooms 3 and 4. kamenrider: 10 second-order themes, 49 concepts read fresh; 10 fit; no new kind, no split; 10 primaries the same; the record holds 2 additional kinds the fresh reading did not give (t02 T3-022, t04 T3-151), the fresh reading 4 not recorded (t01 T3-104, t02 T3-020, t03 T3-028, t05 T3-157). ik_ihe: 6 themes, 15 concepts; 5 fit, 1 bare (t05, a bare pointer to another sub, listed unplaced in the record too, so the readings agree); 5 primaries the same; the record holds 2 additional kinds the fresh reading did not give (t02 T3-113, t03 T3-145, each one concept).

B1c rooms 5 and 6. kurdistan: 6 second-order themes, 43 concepts read fresh; 6 fit; no new kind, no split; 5 primaries the same, 1 disjoint (t02, judged gate fails: T3-068, T3-061 and T3-006 each take replacing another nation's flag with one's own). The record's t03 T3-132 (a rival watching from inside) is used for a sub's thread though its label names a Discord: label too narrow. t06 by the label T3-095, as in the record. poland: 8 themes, 117 concepts; 8 fit; 8 primaries the same; t07's additional kind differs (record T3-080, fresh T3-130, labels overlap for refusing the Pan-Slavic flag). National content read plainly: the Kurdish, YPG, PKK and Rojava flags, Turkmen nationalists, Italian attackers called fascists; Polish partition, Winged Hussars, Pan-Slavism as Russian domination.

B1c room 7 france: 23 second-order themes, 589 concepts read fresh. Fresh verdicts: 21 fit, 2 gate fails (t05, drawing up the room's plan of operations, colours, borders, timing and task order: T3-070, T3-091, T3-066, T3-069 and T3-167 each take part; t09, watching and reporting the live canvas: T3-073 says recounting, and T3-087, T3-052 and T3-154 each take part, as the record's additional kinds show); no new kind, no split. Against the record: 22 primaries the same, 1 swapped within the same two kinds (t20). Additional kinds: the record holds 13 the fresh reading did not give, the fresh reading 12 not recorded; the largest themes (t06, t07, t16) carry three or more kinds by concept in the fresh reading, so their bags in the record may hold the rest. National content read plainly: the war with Germany cast as occupation, Maginot, Overlord and resistance; slurs for Germans (c0130, c0223); the wine-label banter with Italians; whether the European flag was surrender; a warning about electing a fascist.

B1c rooms 8 and 9. vinesauce: 9 second-order themes, 106 concepts read fresh; 9 fit; no new kind, no split; 8 primaries the same, 1 disjoint (t08, judged gate fails: T3-136 and T3-074 both name the shortage of hands). t07's T3-041 says a bigger second piece; Grand Dad is a second piece, not bigger, and whose meme it is has no label (noted, not counted). oman: 6 themes, 24 concepts; 5 fit, 1 gate fails (t06, telling a late helper the canvas is over; the record used T3-073 here and T3-016 in stardustcrusaders t17, the fresh reading T3-117 in both: three kinds for one act); 5 primaries the same, 1 disjoint (t06).

B1c room 10 mexico: 19 second-order themes, 379 concepts read fresh. Fresh verdicts: 17 fit, 1 gate fails (t18, a canvas thread taken over by an insult to Mexicans and off-topic quarrels; the record also put it in T3-017), 1 bare (t19, listed unplaced in the record too); no new kind, no split. Against the record: 14 primaries the same, 2 fresh primaries recorded as additional (t01 T3-020 under the record's T3-065; t17 T3-031 under T3-142), 2 overlaps (t02, where the record chose T3-076 restraint and the fresh reading T3-006 raids, both in the theme; t05, judged gate fails: enlarging the room's own flag has no label, the record used T3-041 a bigger second piece). National content read plainly: Mexico against Argentina, Italy, Spain and the UK; the_donald named as attacker; Trump's wall jokes; an insult to Mexicans; a religious symbol refused as polarising.

B1c room 11 gatech: 10 second-order themes, 124 concepts read fresh. Fresh verdicts: 9 fit, 1 gate fails (t07, declining Europe's call to fight the void: T3-115's label says a rival fandom's request; the record also used T3-115 there, with T3-138 primary); no new kind, no split. Against the record: 9 primaries the same, 1 swapped within the same kinds (t07). t06, Georgia Tech's own April Fools jokes, T3-048 in both readings, whose label still says a company. t04's additional kind differs (record T3-120, fresh T3-088; both labels take lending throwaways to the room's own script).

B1c room 12 PlaceNL: 21 second-order themes, 246 concepts read fresh. Fresh verdicts: 19 fit, 2 gate fails (t11, the room admitting its plan does not control every Dutch placer: T3-126, T3-188, T3-049 and T3-076 each take part, and the record also used T3-126 with T3-049 and T3-087; t19, finding out the canvas has ended, the third case after stardustcrusaders t17 and oman t06); no new kind, no split. Against the record: 16 primaries the same, 1 swapped within the same kinds (t03), 2 overlaps (t09, applications for space: record T3-012, fresh T3-162 with T3-012, both readable; t14, judged gate fails: T3-046 against T3-076 for arguing with the room's own attackers), 2 disjoint (t13, judged gate fails: crossposting between subs has no label, record T3-070 and T3-013, fresh T3-044; t20, a fresh slip: a bare reply to a bot, unplaced in the record). National content read plainly: colonising and the VOC called up, South Africa to be colonised again, Puerto Rico wiped off the map, 'make the Netherlands great again', the Wilhelmus sung.

B1c rooms 13 and 14. VelvetUnderground: 4 second-order themes, 15 concepts read fresh; 4 fit; 4 primaries the same. ubc: 10 themes, 107 concepts; 9 fit, 1 gate fails (t09, announcing the canvas has closed, the fourth case; the record put it in T3-117 here and in PlaceNL t19, T3-016 in stardustcrusaders t17 and T3-073 in oman t06, so T3-117's gate, mourning the end, may need to say registering the end); 10 primaries the same; no new kind, no split. April Fools in ubc t02: the sub turned into SFU's, T3-023 with T3-001, as in the record.

B1c rooms 15 and 16. DevonUK: 6 second-order themes, 24 concepts read fresh; 6 fit; 3 primaries the same, 1 swapped within the same kinds (t03), 2 overlaps judged gate fails (t01, the Devon county flag: the record used T3-065, whose label says national; t02, an outsider finding the sub through its flag: T3-044 and T3-082 each take part). glasgow: 5 themes, 15 concepts; 5 fit; 2 primaries the same, 1 overlap both readable (t01, the saltire call: record T3-065, fresh T3-002), 2 disjoint (t02, judged gate fails: T3-037 and T3-098 both take scorning the canvas talk; t03, a fresh slip: a crude mockery read as a proposal). No new kind, no split. glasgow t04, members' own fake news about the Clyde Tunnel and Squinty Bridge, T3-001 in both readings.

B1c room 17 wholesomememes: 25 second-order themes, 246 concepts read fresh. Fresh verdicts: 22 fit, 2 gate fails (t10, moderators routing posts to sister subs: T3-015 says one official thread, the record used T3-017 and T3-063; t15, April Fools posts removed under ordinary rules: T3-063's label says canvas posts, though both readings used it), 1 bare (t25, unplaced in the record too); no new kind, no split. Against the record: 19 primaries the same, 6 disjoint, 4 of them judged gate fails (t07, T3-003 against T3-038 again; t09, T3-016 against T3-074 for how the cooldown behaved; t12, April Fools prank talk with no fake, record T3-001, fresh T3-017; t13, outside creators' own April Fools releases, record T3-017, fresh T3-048 under the B1b-20 rule, whose label still says the company). Content read plainly: a swastika noticed on Sweden's s (c0103); Greece and Turkey's flags read as friendship after bitter histories.

B1c rooms 18 and 19. cardinals: 9 second-order themes, 102 concepts read fresh; 7 fit, 2 gate fails (t04, declining the canvas as silly: T3-037 and T3-098 both take it, though both readings chose T3-037; t06, watching the canvas and what survived: no label for watching and reporting the canvas, the record T3-073, the fresh reading T3-052 with T3-073); 8 primaries the same, 1 overlap (t06). The Cubs logo defaced into Cubsuck, Cobs and worse placed plainly in T3-006 in both readings. picturegame: 4 themes, 13 concepts; 4 fit; 4 primaries the same; the SoundGame April Fools in T3-023 in both readings. No new kind, no split.

B1c room 20 radiohead: 10 second-order themes, 310 concepts read fresh; 10 fit; no new kind, no split; 10 primaries the same. Additional kinds: the record holds 3 the fresh reading did not give (t03 T3-091, T3-141; t05 T3-156), the fresh reading 8 not recorded (t01 T3-033; t02 T3-015; t03 T3-170, T3-005; t04 T3-011, T3-150; t05 T3-105; t07 T3-012). A Radiohead member threatening the Mexico Discord (c0203) read plainly in t04.

B1c rooms 21 and 22. sixers: 11 second-order themes, 150 concepts read fresh; 11 fit; 11 primaries the same; t11, counting the NBA logos on the canvas, T3-019 in both readings. Fez: 9 themes, 94 concepts; 9 fit; 8 primaries the same, 1 overlap (t07, judged gate fails: the destroy-then-rebuild deal with Denmark is both T3-010 and T3-151, record primary T3-151, fresh T3-010). t03, the game creator's own April Fools tweet, T3-048 in both readings. No new kind, no split. Content read plainly: trolls turning Gomez into Hitler (Fez c0054), the Danish Discord's orders failing on the canvas (c0059, c0094).
